item.title: Cross ~Koi no Hizashi~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: SSB Co., Ltd.
  • 発売日: 1999-03-26
  • スコア: なし (2 人評価)
  • 日本語名: CROSS ～恋の陽射～
  • 英語名: Cross Koi no Hizashi

别名

  • クロス

あらすじ

While carrying his friends’ luggage to their hotel room, our guy met three beautiful girls. Later, he and his two friends meet the three girls and he can choose one to chase. In 7 days on this paradise island resort, he can chase one girl. If he faisl to catch anyone, he gets the consolation prize of being a father.
